既然一鱼可以多吃，那么一流可不可以两用呢？？？
答案是：可以的！！！

❤️❤️❤️这是一个选择器：
1.当“切换任意”节点的布尔值为真时，代表选择一键迁移服装工作流
2.当“切换任意”节点的布尔值为假时，代表选择一键迁移产品工作流



Since one fish can be eaten in multiple menus, can one workflow be used for two purposes?
The answer is: yes!!!

❤️❤️❤️This is a selector:
1. When the boolean value of the "Switch Any" node is true, it represents selecting the one-click Clothing migration workflow.
2. When the boolean value of the "Switch Any" node is false, it represents selecting the one-click Product migration workflow.

1️⃣默认情况下此框内节点无需操作
2️⃣当自动遮罩无法满足需求时，按以下步骤操作:
1）将此框内“切换任意”节点的布尔值设置为false
2）在Concact Pixel图框内右键“执行框内节点”
3）在Concact Pixel图框内的桥接预览图像节点右键“在遮罩编辑器中打开”手动涂抹遮罩
4）重新点击“执行队列”运行工作流

1️⃣ By default, no operation is required on the node in this box
2️⃣ When the auto mask does not meet the demand, follow these steps:
1) Set the Boolean value of "Switch Any" node in this box to false
2) Right-click "Execute Frame Node" in the Concact Pixel frame
3) Manually apply the mask by right-clicking on the Bridge Preview image node in the Concact Pixel frame and "Open in Mask Editor"
4) Click "Queue" again to run the workflow

1️⃣默认情况下此框内节点无需操作
2️⃣当你发现抠图效果不理想时，可以尝试将布尔值调整为false,以切换本地版的抠图节点
3️⃣我这里采用的是Easy Use的RMBG节点，你也可以更改为任何其他的本地抠图节点


1️⃣By default, the nodes in this box do not need to be manipulated.
2️⃣If you find that the masking effect is not ideal, you can try adjusting the Boolean value to false to switch to the local version of the masking node.
3️⃣I am using the Easy Use RMBG node here, but you can also replace it with any other local masking node.
